hermeticity.method: I first built focus-only models from the two focus roots and their complete branch inventories, then replayed the context_root_cues in packet order and retained distinct anchored changes without selecting a final interpretation.
hermeticity.limitations: This is a reconstructed focus trace, not a strict blind staged log: the sealed packet exposed the focus ayah and all context at once. The ordering below reconstructs likely activations retrospectively, using ordinary Arabic morphology but no external sources.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مُورِيَٰتِ from و ر ي and the manner/result accusative قَدْحًا from ق د ح.
baseline_models.mechanism: Plural agents apply contact that makes a previously hidden fire emerge; the second word specifies the striking operation rather than merely adding a second fire image.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: A fire is latent in the fire-stick and comes out.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Supplies the concealed potential and its emergence.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: Fire is struck or kindled from a stick, stone, or implement.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Supplies the physical operation that releases the latent fire.

changed_reading.after: The agents are defined by converting repeated contact into the appearance of a fire that was present but inaccessible.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causative force of مُورِيَٰتِ and the material-contact range of قَدْحًا.
baseline_models.mechanism: The strike is also a breach: it scores a covering surface, and the brief emission is evidence that something hidden lay behind it. Light and damage coexist rather than cancel one another.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: A thing is covered and placed out of sight.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: A physical thing is scored, bored, split, or marked.

changed_reading.before: The spark is only a bright product.
changed_reading.after: The spark is a disclosure event produced by breaching a cover, while the scored substrate preserves evidence of the contact.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مُورِيَٰتِ retains the fire-stick idiom of taking successfully, while قَدْحًا can describe working an affair out by consideration.
baseline_models.mechanism: The physical catching of fire supports an operational analogy: deliberate probing makes an undertaking catch, and aid converts an inert possibility into effective action.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: A fire-stick taking can image success, aid, counsel, or defense.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: An affair is examined and planned.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Supplies deliberate probing as the means by which the affair takes.

changed_reading.after: Agents make a difficult possibility take through planned probing, aid, and successful activation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Form-distant but packet-attested branches of both و ر ي and ق د ح converge on an eating process inside a body or material.
baseline_models.mechanism: Instead of treating every emission as healthy ignition, the focus can carry a diagnostic shadow: surface scoring may disclose a process already consuming the inside.

discarded_or_unchanged: The spatial far-side, descendant, and people-on-earth ranges of و ر ي did not produce a distinct mechanism that remained better anchored than concealment and emergence.
The lineage-aspersion and drinking-cup ranges of ق د ح remained lexically available but required imported scenarios and did not change the focus reading.
The lean-horse and sunken-eye range of ق د ح echoed exertion or depletion but merely repeated stronger kinetic and interior-diagnostic models.
Faunal, plant-name, place-name, and proper-name branches in context were unchanged because they supplied no causal bridge back to مُورِيَٰتِ or قَدْحًا.
Morning as timing alone was unchanged; it was retained only where dawn, lamp, and change of visible state formed a mechanism.
The water, food, and raised-voice ranges of ن ق ع generated analogies, but none changed the focus more distinctly than the raised-dust plume.

strongest_changes: 100:1 converts isolated fire-making into a kinetic sequence in which strenuous motion and repeated contact release latent fire.
100:7 and 100:9 turn spark and score into evidence: a hidden event witnesses itself, then expands into an exhumation model of forced disclosure.
100:10-11 make the strike an interior assay whose outward result reveals a covered causal source.
100:8 separates activation from benefit by opposing real ignition to sterile sparks.
100:6 activates the focus fire-stick idiom as received aid that can later be denied or severed.
summary.what_was_special: The focus pairing of hidden fire with scoring proved unusually generative: later roots repeatedly changed it from spectacle into threshold, witness, exhumation, and assay. Split mappings preserved a counted-return pulse and a remaining-trace reading. Form-distant but exact branch echoes also kept three live outliers: gathered lots, inward corrosion, and tender emergence.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet does not settle whether the feminine-plural agents across 100:1-5 are one continuing set or formally parallel sets.
It remains uncertain how strongly the later ethical and interior vocabulary should retroactively metaphorize the physical focus scene.
The non-dominant split mappings may represent productive latent resonance or only lexicographic proximity.
The accusative grammar of قَدْحًا constrains the nominal lot and plant-tip branches, so those readings remain analogical rather than replacement parses.
